entities.name: Ben-Ben
entities.description: A foul-smelling outcast akki hermit who manipulates stones with his mind.

entities.name: Yamazaki brothers
entities.description: Brothers who joined Ben-Ben in a summoning ritual.

events.summary: Ben-Ben was banished from the Ishi tribe's caves for his smell.
events.quote: Ben-Ben belonged to the Ishi tribe before he was banished from the caves for his smell

events.summary: Ben-Ben was present at Kobo's acceptance into the Hyozan Reckoners.
events.quote: He was present in Hidetsugu 's hut during the ritual of Kobo's acceptance

events.summary: Ben-Ben and the Yamazaki brothers summoned the Myojin of Infinite Rage.
events.quote: participated together with the brothers Yamazaki in a ritual summoning the Myojin of Infinite Rage
